name: kanzo-ui
description: Kanzo design system — a domain-free component library over Ark UI, the design tokens it is themed by, and the colour derivation behind them.

scripts.//lint: packages *and* docs. `docs/` was outside this for as long as it existed, so 13,000 lines of showcase went unlinted — including the four Node scripts that produce BENCHMARKS.md.
scripts.//check:generated: themes.css and theme-data.json are generated — the catalogue of themes plus the non-colour axes. Regenerate and fail if the checked-in copies differ, so a hand-edit or a stale commit cannot ship. `tokens.css` and `themes/*.css` are NOT here: they are hand-written source now, and a guard that regenerated them would have nothing to regenerate them from.
scripts.check:generated: pnpm --filter @kanzo-tech/theme gen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/theme/themes.css packages/theme/theme-data.json
scripts.//release: Scoped to packages/*: the docs app must never sit on the publish path.
